reflection.candidate_lesson: When the 30-indicator consensus shows conv=100% but green_matches < 4 AND hist_hr is populated, the historical-memory analog is too thin to trust the live conviction — gate entries on green_matches >= 4 to require historical confirmation, not just live agreement.
reflection.mechanism: Live indicator agreement measures present-tense crowding; green_matches counts how many times this exact multi-indicator fingerprint previously resolved profitably. A 100% live consensus with only 3 historical analogs (AUDUSD case) is a fresh, unvalidated configuration — institutions have not yet been observed reacting to this pattern, so the 68% hist_hr is a small-sample mirage that regresses toward base rate when traded at size.
reflection.testable_rule: if consensus_conviction >= 1.00 and green_matches < 4: reduce_size_multiplier(0.5) or skip; only full-size when green_matches >= 5 AND hist_hr >= 0.65

validation.reason: Rule filters only 0 trades — insufficient sample
